content_feed.headline: Swastika Infra Wins Rs 615.76 Crore MSEDCL Contract
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Material order win worth over Rs 600 crore from a state utility.
content_feed.telegram_post: 📜 #ORDER_WIN | Swastika Infra Limited (NSE: SWASTIKAIN) Swastika Infra Secures Rs 615.76 Cr Order from MSEDCL ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Client: Maharashtra State Electricity Distribution Company Limited (MSEDCL) - Order Value: ₹615.76 crore (including taxes) - Scope: Distribution Infrastructure & System Strengthening works - Geography: Bhandup Zone, Maharashtra - Execution Period: 24 months from LOA 📌 What happened: ↳ The company received a Letter of Award (LOA) for survey, design, engineering, supply, installation, testing, and commissioning of distribution infrastructure and associated civil and electrical works. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing

content_feed.headline: Asset Reconstruction Company (India) reports Q1FY27 standalone PAT at Rs. 143.1 crore, up 107% YoY
content_feed.worthiness_reason: Strong Q1 financial results report with numeric revenue and PAT growth figures.
content_feed.telegram_post: 📊 #RESULT | Asset Reconstruction Company (India) Limited (NSE: ARCIL) ARCIL reports Q1FY27 results: PAT doubles to Rs. 143.1 crore on higher recoveries ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 🔹 Key Details: - Total Income: Rs. 276.1 crore vs Rs. 128.5 crore (up 115% YoY) - Profit After Tax (PAT): Rs. 143.1 crore vs Rs. 69.1 crore (up 107% YoY) - Assets Under Management (AUM): Rs. 19,574 crore (up 16% YoY) - Total Recovery: Rs. 1,066.0 crore vs Rs. 425.0 crore (up 151% YoY) - Acquisitions: Rs. 352.7 crore vs Rs. 502.2 crore (down 30% YoY) 📌 What happened: ↳ ARCIL announced its audited standalone and consolidated financial results for the quarter ended June 30, 2026, driven by a sharp rise in recoveries and fee income. ━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━━ 📌 Source: NSE Corporate Filing
